reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical tone. Perfectly maintains human approval boundaries and omits sales CTAs as required.
reasons.clarity: Exceptionally clear, structured, and easy to follow on a first read. The workflow boundary and core questions are stated plainly without technical jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, low-friction diagnostic step (auditing one week of invoices) and explicit threshold questions before deciding on automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes zero unsupported claims, invents no customers or results, and explicitly treats the proposed review as a process check rather than an outcome.
